description: Search ElfHosted's catalogue of apps and bundles by name or by what you want done, such as "photos" or "password manager". Returns each match's name, a short description, its live price and its store link. With no search words, AIOStreams, Immich, OpenClaw and Hermes come first.

limit.description: How many to return (1 to 20, default 10).

query.description: An app name, such as "aiostreams", "immich" or "plex", or what it should do, such as "photos", "recipes" or "media server". Leave out to list the featured apps, then the first page of the catalogue.

name: browse_apps
title: Browse apps
